wrapping.value: Considering only text required to be visible by the current selection and disclosure rules, are all visible title, subtitle, notice, choice labels, visible item details/reasons, visible disclosure content, summary, action label and footer words readable in natural wrapped lines without truncation or ellipsis? Deliberately collapsed guidance and unselected incident dossiers are excluded. If required text is missing, answer unknown and identify it; missing text cannot count as correct wrapping. Visible word clipping or ellipsis answers false. Evaluate wrapping only; spacing collisions have their own atom. A true answer still requires complete exact-state coverage.

overlap.value: Across every captured part of this exact state, do text, choice indicators, status badges, disclosure content and primary action occupy separate areas without unintended overlap or occlusion? Evaluate overlap only; line breaking has its own atom.

trust_limit: Identity and exact typed derivation only. Authorship, design correctness and approval require a separate preimplementation review record.
